title: Final boss: find the culprit
hints: README → New syntax: `x=$( ... )` stores one command's output for the next command.
Step 1: the top user ID, via the level-16 recipe on ERROR lines. Step 2: find that ID at the start of a users.csv line and keep name and email.
`id=$(grep ERROR "$DATA/app.log" | grep -o 'user=u[0-9]*' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)`, then `grep "^$id,"` users.csv and keep fields 2-3.
Golfers: one awk can do the whole thing with an NR==FNR join.
